name: @dropecho/dropecho.testing
description: Runs every *Tests.hx class on the classpath with utest or buddy, found at compile time, plus a CLI that builds and runs them on each Haxe target.
author: vantreeseba <vantreeseba@gmail.com>

scripts.test: npm run build && haxe --main dropecho.testing.AutoTest test.hxml && neko artifacts/test/run_tests.n
